overview: EasyBuy is an Expo-based React Native ecommerce client with user and admin flows, backed in-repo by an Express mock API that serves catalog, checkout, order, user, category, upload, and dashboard endpoints.

domain_models.name: User
domain_models.definition: Authenticated person persisted in secure storage and identified as either USER or ADMIN for route and API authorization.

domain_models.name: Session
domain_models.definition: Stored auth state containing the signed-in user and x-auth-token, reused by navigation guards and every authenticated API request.

domain_models.name: Category
domain_models.definition: Top-level merchandising grouping with title, description, and icon metadata used by both the storefront and admin CRUD screens.

domain_models.name: Product
domain_models.definition: Sellable catalog item with title, SKU, price, quantity, description, image, and category reference.

domain_models.name: CartItem
domain_models.definition: Redux-managed selected product plus quantity, used to build checkout totals and payloads.

domain_models.name: Order
domain_models.definition: Placed purchase containing purchaser identity, line items, address fields, delivery status, timestamps, and derived payment metadata.

domain_models.name: Payment
domain_models.definition: Checkout payment contract encoded by payment_type, payment_status, payment_reference, payment_message, and wallet acknowledgement rules.

domain_models.name: WishlistEntry
domain_models.definition: Saved product association exposed through wishlist endpoints and profile screens for later purchase consideration.

domain_models.name: DashboardMetric
domain_models.definition: Admin aggregate count of users, orders, products, and categories used to power the dashboard cards.

domain_models.name: UploadedPhoto
domain_models.definition: Product or category image uploaded to the mock server and later resolved through the shared image URL seam.
